dialogues.jp: 「……腹減ったなぁ」
dialogues.en: "I'm starving."
dialogues.text: "I'm starving."

dialogues.jp:
窓の外になんとなく視線を送りながら、教員棟
にある食堂を目指す。
dialogues.en:
I walk to the dining hall in the faculty building, looking
out of the window.
dialogues.text:
I walk to the dining hall in the faculty building, looking
out of the window.

dialogues.jp: 「今日の日替わり定食は何かな」
dialogues.en: "I wonder what today's daily lunch special is."
dialogues.text: "I wonder what today's daily lunch special is."

dialogues.jp: 安価な定食なのだが、思わず胸が小躍る。
dialogues.en: It's not really a wonderful meal, but I can't wait for that.
dialogues.text: It's not really a wonderful meal, but I can't wait for that.

dialogues.jp:
自宅での貧しい食料事情を考えると、食堂のお
ばちゃんの手による大量生産の定食すらありが
たいのだ。
dialogues.en:
Thinking of my diet situation at home, I would greatly
appreciate even the mass-produced entree from the old gals
in the dining hall.
dialogues.text:
Thinking of my diet situation at home, I would greatly
appreciate even the mass-produced entree from the old gals
in the dining hall.

dialogues.jp:
あったかいご飯と味噌汁のコンビネーションだ
と最高なのだが、まぁ贅沢は言うまい。
dialogues.en:
It would be great if it's hot rice and miso soup, but
whatever it is I wouldn't complain.
dialogues.text:
It would be great if it's hot rice and miso soup, but
whatever it is I wouldn't complain.

dialogues.jp:
決して、大根を下ろした季節はずれの｛さんま／秋刀魚｝が
食べたいなんて言うまい。
dialogues.en:
I wouldn't ask for unseasonal Pacific saury with grated
radish.
dialogues.text:
I wouldn't ask for unseasonal Pacific saury with grated
radish.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おっ、朝倉、こんなところにいたのか」
dialogues.en: "Hey, I didn't know you were here."
dialogues.text: "Hey, I didn't know you were here."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……なんとなく、今、お前にだけは会いたく
　なかったぞ」
dialogues.en: "I didn't want to see you here."
dialogues.text: "I didn't want to see you here."

dialogues.jp:
背中からの声に振り返ると、ひとりで元気玉を
作れそうなテンションの男が立っていた。
dialogues.en: Looking behind me, I see a guy standing tensely.
dialogues.text: Looking behind me, I see a guy standing tensely.

dialogues.jp: 「俺のささやかな幸せを奪うつもりなら帰れ」
dialogues.en:
"If you're thinking of taking my little pleasure away, you'd
better bugger off now."
dialogues.text:
"If you're thinking of taking my little pleasure away, you'd
better bugger off now."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、なんでもない……で、なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, nothing... so, what is it?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, nothing... so, what is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「外を見ろ朝倉ッ！」
dialogues.en: "Look outside!"
dialogues.text: "Look outside!"

dialogues.jp: 言われた通り窓の外に視線を戻す。
dialogues.en: I look outside as he says.
dialogues.text: I look outside as he says.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「陽光降り注ぐピクニック日和だ！」
dialogues.en: "It's a great day for a picnic on a sunny afternoon."
dialogues.text: "It's a great day for a picnic on a sunny afternoon."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「本気で帰れ！　どこの馬鹿がこのクソ寒い中
　で飯を食うか！」
dialogues.en:
"Get out of here! Who the hell wants to eat lunch outside in
this cold weather?!"
dialogues.text:
"Get out of here! Who the hell wants to eat lunch outside in
this cold weather?!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「貴様、風見学園七不思議“ピクニックの神様”
　を知らんのか！？」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, I guess you haven't heard of one of the seven wonders
in this Kazami Academy, which is the 'God of Picnics'."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, I guess you haven't heard of one of the seven wonders
in this Kazami Academy, which is the 'God of Picnics'."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なんだその、状況が一片も思い浮かばない不
　思議は……」
dialogues.en:
"How strange is it to not have any idea what you're talking
about?"
dialogues.text:
"How strange is it to not have any idea what you're talking
about?"

dialogues.jp:
そもそも、開校７年のうちの学園に七不思議が
あることすら初耳だぞ。
dialogues.en:
To begin with, I've never heard of there being seven wonders
in this school which opened only seven years ago.
dialogues.text:
To begin with, I've never heard of there being seven wonders
in this school which opened only seven years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふっ、それはそうだろう。俺も最近仕入れた
　ネタだからな」
dialogues.en:
"Hah, of course, you've never heard of it. Because I only
got this news recently myself."
dialogues.text:
"Hah, of course, you've never heard of it. Because I only
got this news recently myself."

dialogues.jp:
その情報源を殺しておいたほうがいいかな、と
物騒な考えが頭をよぎる。
dialogues.en:
The way he's not disclosing the news source terrifies me a
bit.
dialogues.text:
The way he's not disclosing the news source terrifies me a
bit.

dialogues.jp: 「ともかくだ――」
dialogues.en: "Anyhow..."
dialogues.text: "Anyhow..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おにょ？　あ、お兄ちゃんだ♪」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Oh, oniichan!"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Oh, oniichan!"

dialogues.jp:
声がしたかと思うと、突如、腰になにかがしが
みつく。
dialogues.en:
As soon as I hear the voice, I feel someone clinging around
my waist.
dialogues.text:
As soon as I hear the voice, I feel someone clinging around
my waist.

dialogues.jp: 「……さくら」
dialogues.en: "Sakura..."
dialogues.text: "Sakura..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにやってる？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それは俺の台詞のような気がするが……食堂
　に行こうかとな」
dialogues.en:
"That's my line... Anyway, I was thinking of going to the
dining hall."
dialogues.text:
"That's my line... Anyway, I was thinking of going to the
dining hall."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクも行く〜」
dialogues.en: "I'll go with you."
dialogues.text: "I'll go with you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「仕方ない。ピクニックの神様の呪いも恐ろし
　いが、愛と勇気を振り絞って俺も食堂へ行こ
　う」
dialogues.en:
"What else can I do? Although the curse of the God of
Picnics is horrible, I'll go to the dining hall with you,
gathering love and courage."
dialogues.text:
"What else can I do? Although the curse of the God of
Picnics is horrible, I'll go to the dining hall with you,
gathering love and courage."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前の愛と勇気なんて、すでに絞った雑巾み
　たいに、渾身の力をこめんと出てこないだろ
　うが」
dialogues.en:
"Love and courage wouldn't come out of you unless we squeeze
you like a half-dried rag."
dialogues.text:
"Love and courage wouldn't come out of you unless we squeeze
you like a half-dried rag."

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、こいつのことだから、季節はずれの転入
生である、さくらの観察でもしたいのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Oh, well. I know he must want to check out Sakura, since she
transferred here at such an odd time.
dialogues.text:
Oh, well. I know he must want to check out Sakura, since she
transferred here at such an odd time.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おにょ、杉並くんも行くの？」
dialogues.en: "Hm, are you going, too, Suginami?"
dialogues.text: "Hm, are you going, too, Suginami?"

dialogues.jp:
俺が呼んでいたのを聞いたのだろう。人見知り
の薄いさくらが、杉並の名前を呼びながら見上
げる。
dialogues.en:
I think Sakura must have heard me say his name. Sakura looks
up at him in a friendly way as she calls him by name.
dialogues.text:
I think Sakura must have heard me say his name. Sakura looks
up at him in a friendly way as she calls him by name.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　なにか問題でもあるか？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Is there any problem?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Is there any problem?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……ないけどね」
dialogues.en: "Not really..."
dialogues.text: "Not really..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ、なるほど……悪いなふたりとも、俺は
　急に用事を思い出すことにした」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, I see... Sorry, guys. I just remembered an errand to
do."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, I see... Sorry, guys. I just remembered an errand to
do."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「俺の分もたんまり食べてきてくれ」
dialogues.en: "Enjoy the meal for me, too."
dialogues.text: "Enjoy the meal for me, too."

dialogues.jp:
杉並は手を掲げて気持ち悪く笑いながら、教室
のほうへ帰っていった。
dialogues.en:
Suginami walks away to the classroom, raising his hands high
with a disgusting grin.
dialogues.text:
Suginami walks away to the classroom, raising his hands high
with a disgusting grin.

dialogues.jp:
「なんだアイツ？　ついに電波でも受信した
　か？」
dialogues.en:
"What the hell? Did a radio wave finally get through to
him?"
dialogues.text:
"What the hell? Did a radio wave finally get through to
him?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ〜……まっ、いっか♪　食堂にゴーだよお
　兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en:
"Well, try not to worry. Let's go to the dining hall,
oniichan!"
dialogues.text:
"Well, try not to worry. Let's go to the dining hall,
oniichan!"

dialogues.jp:
ようやく腰から離れたさくらが、指を合わせて
相好を崩す。
dialogues.en: Sakura finally lets go of my waist and smiles ear to ear.
dialogues.text: Sakura finally lets go of my waist and smiles ear to ear.

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、そうだな。時間ももったいないし」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, you're right. We don't wanna waste our time."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, you're right. We don't wanna waste our time."

dialogues.jp:
頭をかいて、さくらを案内するようなつもりで
食堂に行くことにした。
dialogues.en:
Scratching my head, I decide to head over to the dining hall
with her under my guidance.
dialogues.text:
Scratching my head, I decide to head over to the dining hall
with her under my guidance.

dialogues.jp:
中庭を抜けて教員棟に入り、すぐのところが食
堂だ。
dialogues.en:
Passing through the yard to the faculty building, you'll see
the dining hall soon.
dialogues.text:
Passing through the yard to the faculty building, you'll see
the dining hall soon.

dialogues.jp:
学生数のわりに敷地が広いおかげで、席がない
ということはないが、やはり人が多い。
dialogues.en:
The school area is too big for the number of students, so
there's no problem finding seats, but I think there are
still a lot of students here.
dialogues.text:
The school area is too big for the number of students, so
there's no problem finding seats, but I think there are
still a lot of students here.

dialogues.jp: 「食堂の使い方は誰かに教えてもらったか？」
dialogues.en: "Has anybody told you the procedure in the dining hall?"
dialogues.text: "Has anybody told you the procedure in the dining hall?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うんん。今日がはじめてだよ」
dialogues.en: "Nope. It's the first time for me to be here."
dialogues.text: "Nope. It's the first time for me to be here."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そっか。とりあえず簡単に説明すると……」
dialogues.en: "I see. I'll explain it to you briefly..."
dialogues.text: "I see. I'll explain it to you briefly..."

dialogues.jp: 腕を組んで少しだけ考える。
dialogues.en: I cross my arms and think for a couple of seconds.
dialogues.text: I cross my arms and think for a couple of seconds.

dialogues.jp:
「説明と言うか、食券を買って料理をもらうか
　購買でパンかなんかを買うくらいか」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it's not complicated. All you do is you buy the
ticket for the dish you want, or buy some bread at the
store."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it's not complicated. All you do is you buy the
ticket for the dish you want, or buy some bread at the
store."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ま、普通だね」
dialogues.en: "It's the same way."
dialogues.text: "It's the same way."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり、こういうシステムはどこの国でも
　同じなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is the lunch system the same in every country?"
dialogues.text: "Is the lunch system the same in every country?"

dialogues.jp:
食券の券売機を目指しながら、なんとなく興味
本位に聞いてみる。
dialogues.en:
I ask her out of curiosity as I point to the vending machine
for the ticket.
dialogues.text:
I ask her out of curiosity as I point to the vending machine
for the ticket.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、入り口で決まったマネーを払って、
　バイキングにしてるところもあるけどね」
dialogues.en:
"Um... We sometimes pay money first at the entrance, then go
for the all-you-can-eat buffet."
dialogues.text:
"Um... We sometimes pay money first at the entrance, then go
for the all-you-can-eat buffet."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なるほど」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「後、お米も出たりするし、メニューは中華が
　結構多いんだよ……やっぱり食文化は東洋の
　勝ちだね♪」
dialogues.en:
"And you can also order rice. There's lots of Chinese food,
believe it or not. I think Oriental dishes are the most
popular."
dialogues.text:
"And you can also order rice. There's lots of Chinese food,
believe it or not. I think Oriental dishes are the most
popular."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、日本｛びいき／贔屓｝はおいといて、とりあえずな
　に食うか決めよう」
dialogues.en:
"Well, that's enough Japanisms. Let's order something to eat
now."
dialogues.text:
"Well, that's enough Japanisms. Let's order something to eat
now."

dialogues.jp: 品目と値段の書かれた券売機を示す。
dialogues.en:
I point out the vending machine, which displays the menu and
the price.
dialogues.text:
I point out the vending machine, which displays the menu and
the price.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、安いね♪」
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's cheap."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's cheap."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「その変わり、味も値段相応だけどな」
dialogues.en: "I'll warn you the taste matches the price, though."
dialogues.text: "I'll warn you the taste matches the price, though."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お勧めはなにかな？　ボク、お兄ちゃんと同
　じ物がいいなぁ」
dialogues.en:
"What do you recommend? I wanna eat the same thing you eat,
oniichan."
dialogues.text:
"What do you recommend? I wanna eat the same thing you eat,
oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「同じ物か」
dialogues.en: "The same thing?"
dialogues.text: "The same thing?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は券売機のボタンを見つめる。
dialogues.en: I stare at the vending machine's buttons.
dialogues.text: I stare at the vending machine's buttons.

dialogues.jp: ◆券売機の説明◆
dialogues.en: ◆Instruction for the vending machine◆
dialogues.text: ◆Instruction for the vending machine◆

dialogues.jp:
ピクニック日和とか抜かす杉並を無視して、さ
くらと一緒に食堂を訪れる。
dialogues.en:
I go to the dining hall with Sakura, ignoring Suginami's
suggestion of a picnic.
dialogues.text:
I go to the dining hall with Sakura, ignoring Suginami's
suggestion of a picnic.

dialogues.jp:
券売機の説明をすると、さくらは俺と同じモノ
を食べると言うのだが……。
dialogues.en:
When I explained about the vending machine, Sakura wanted to
order the same thing I order.
dialogues.text:
When I explained about the vending machine, Sakura wanted to
order the same thing I order.

dialogues.jp:
この食堂には未知の料理を出すボタンがある。
そこで――。
dialogues.en:
This dining hall has a special button for a meal I don't
know. Therefore...
dialogues.text:
This dining hall has a special button for a meal I don't
know. Therefore...
